# twenty_object

Manages a workspace-custom object through Metadata GraphQL. Reads and mutations require the `DATA_MODEL` settings permission; the provider's reads select the guarded icon field. Built-in, system, remote, and application-owned objects are protected, even when Twenty marks them editable or non-system. Use the [object data source](../data-sources/object.md) to look up those objects.

## Example usage

```terraform
resource "twenty_object" "subscription" {
  name_singular  = "subscription"
  name_plural    = "subscriptions"
  label_singular = "Subscription"
  label_plural   = "Subscriptions"
  description    = "Customer subscriptions"
  icon           = "IconRepeat"

  # Apply false before destroying. Destruction drops all fields and records.
  deletion_protection = true
}
```

Names are unique across singular and plural names. Changing either name replaces the object. Labels are independent and can be updated. Start labels with an uppercase letter when the first character has case, because Twenty capitalizes them during creation. Use canonical strings with single spaces and no surrounding whitespace. Description and icon default to empty strings, matching Twenty's read responses. Omission or null clears them.

Twenty creates the object's default name and system fields, default view, and navigation entry. Generated default fields belong to Twenty, not separate Terraform field resources. This resource does not manage unrelated object settings or CRM records.

## Deletion

Deletion protection defaults to true. Apply `deletion_protection = false` before destroying the resource. Deletion immediately drops the object table and cascades all fields and CRM data. It does not deactivate the object first. Replacement requires deletion too, so changing names can destroy data.

## Import

Import a workspace-custom object's native UUID. Import does not grant ownership over protected objects. Protection defaults to true after import.

```shell
# Replace the placeholder with the workspace-custom object's native UUID.
terraform import twenty_object.subscription 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```

Match configuration to the imported values before applying. Creation never adopts objects by name.

## Partial failures

The provider does not retry mutations. After receiving a valid creation UUID, it retains that ID even if read-back fails. If creation fails without a confirmed UUID, inspect Twenty and explicitly import the intended custom object by native UUID. Retrying will reject an existing matching name rather than adopt it.

Update and delete errors retain state. Restore access and refresh before retrying. The shared mutation lock covers only one provider configuration, not other aliases, runs, or administrators.

## Schema

### Required

- `label_plural` (String) Nonblank plural display label, independent of the name. Start with an uppercase letter when the first character has case. Use single spaces with no surrounding whitespace.
- `label_singular` (String) Nonblank singular display label, independent of the name. Start with an uppercase letter when the first character has case. Use single spaces with no surrounding whitespace.
- `name_plural` (String) Unique ASCII lowerCamelCase plural name, at most 63 characters. Must differ from the singular name. Changing it replaces the object.
- `name_singular` (String) Unique ASCII lowerCamelCase singular name, at most 63 characters. Changing it replaces the object. Creation never adopts by name.

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Defaults to true, including on import. Apply false before destroying. Deletion permanently drops the table and all fields and records without deactivating it first.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string. Omission or null clears it. Use single spaces with no surrounding whitespace.
- `icon` (String) Icon identifier. Defaults to an empty string. Omission or null clears it. Use single spaces with no surrounding whitespace.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Native object UUID used for import.
